title: Changing the Min later does not change an open work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with a Min of $15.00.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click Edit Customer.
  3. Change the Min shop supplies charge to $30.00.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • The window opens.

Step 3:

  • $30.00 shows.

Step 4:

  • The customer is saved.

Step 5:

  • "Shop supplies" still reads $15.00: nothing is recalculated.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-E1: “If the customer's Min shop supplies charge changes later, open work orders keep the amount they have; nothing is recalculated.”
